Class AppCoordinator

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.AppCoordinator
All Implemented Interfaces:
ResponseVisitor
public class AppCoordinator extends Object implements ResponseVisitor
Mediator between the network layer and the view layer.

Implements ResponseVisitor to receive ServerResponse objects from the network thread, convert them to view-layer events, and forward them to the active GameUI. Also serialises ClientRequest objects sent by the UI back to the server via the ServerConnection.

A built-in dispatch pacer spaces UI-bound responses at least DISPATCH_MIN_DELAY_MS apart so event overlays are readable. Heartbeat (ping) responses bypass the pacer. A background ping scheduler sends keep-alive requests at a fixed rate and triggers disconnection when the server stops responding.

    • startPingScheduler

      public void startPingScheduler(int pingRatioMs, long serverTimeoutMs)
      Starts a background task that periodically pings the server and triggers GameUI.onServerDisconnected() if no response is seen within serverTimeoutMs.
      Parameters:
      pingRatioMs - interval between pings, in milliseconds
      serverTimeoutMs - maximum time since the last server activity before the connection is considered lost, in milliseconds

    • stopPingScheduler

      public void stopPingScheduler()
      Stops the background ping scheduler, if running.

    • requestShutdown

      public void requestShutdown()
      Single entry point screens can use to terminate the application. Delegates to the active UI's shutdown() so the GUI X-button crash-avoidance path (consume + cleanup thread + halt) is reused — direct Platform.exit() from a screen reopens the same AppKit/Glass race on macOS.

    • handleServerResponse

      public void handleServerResponse(ServerResponse serverResponse)
      Entry point for responses received from the network layer. Heartbeats are forwarded immediately; other responses are paced (see DISPATCH_MIN_DELAY_MS, EVENT_DISPATCH_DELAY_MS) so the UI has time to display each one.
      Parameters:
      serverResponse - the response received from the server
